$comment: SYNTHETIC starter corpus. Written by an AI, not by department champions. It is a regression gate — it tells you if a prompt or model change broke routing. It is NOT evidence that routing accuracy is good on real employee requests. Replace or extend with champion-authored cases and corrections harvested from CorrectionLog. expectedDepartment uses Team.slug so it stays stable across environments.

cases.inputText: My laptop won't turn on. I've tried holding the power button and it does nothing, no lights at all.
I can't connect to the VPN from home. It says authentication failed but my password works for email.
Need access to the shared drive for the finance folder. My manager approved it last week.
The printer on the second floor is jamming every time I try to print more than five pages.
I forgot my password and I'm locked out of my account. I have a meeting in ten minutes.
Outlook keeps crashing when I open attachments. Started this morning after the update.
New hire starts Monday and needs a laptop, a monitor and access to the scheduling system.
The wifi in the east wing keeps dropping. Several of us have noticed it since yesterday.
Please install Adobe Acrobat on my workstation, I need to edit PDFs for compliance paperwork.
My monitor flickers and goes black for a second every few minutes. Swapping the cable didn't help.
The scheduling application is down for the entire floor, nobody can log in. This is blocking shift handover.

My paycheck is missing overtime from last week. I worked two extra shifts on Tuesday and Thursday.
I need to submit PTO for the last week of next month but the request form is rejecting my dates.

Our VP's calendar needs rearranging for the site visit, several meetings will have to move.

What is the current status of the pending applications submitted in the last batch?
I need clarification on which supporting documents are required for a renewal submission.

We have a follow-up task queue that hasn't been assigned to anyone this week.
